method: Lock the current-main canonical snapshot before editorial selection.
Review all 365 July cards; use top cards as structural-anchor candidates, high cards as reinforcement/counterevidence and mid cards as overreach/early-signal checks rather than article-count votes.
Derive the thesis before consulting legacy Vol.09; use the legacy issue only after thesis lock to red-team omissions and inherited framing.
Map the full month across both topic and execution stage so RFP, award, contract, financing, FID/construction, energization and COD are not conflated.
Reject simple EV-down/ESS-replaces-EV framing unless independently governed evidence establishes that causal substitution; ESS production growth alone is not sufficient.
Apply a separate SBTL pouch lens that requires form-factor/customer-program evidence before translating ESS growth into pouch-film demand.
Inspect post-month follow-up only as counterevidence; later facts do not become official July refs.

Select a compact 19-card official evidence set and require every public ref to preserve the locked canonical title and use a validator-accepted governed URL that supports the complete title; quarantine non-indispensable cards when that contract cannot be met.
Preserve the September 14 publication as immutable R1 history and publish the September 15 post-publication remediation as R2; do not backdate QC or approval for content that did not exist on R1.

post_month_counterevidence.finding: China tax authority clarified on 2026-08-27 that battery clusters assembled from cells are taxable battery packs while a complete ESS integrated with electrical, thermal, fire and control systems is not itself a taxable battery product. This narrows the watch wording without changing the July rule event.
